deterministic_repair_rule: Apply approved aliases; LLM reviews unfamiliar headers against an allowlist; reject unresolved required fields.
Classify headers and sample rows once; use only an approved parser route; quarantine new sources or unsupported structures.
Normalize known labels; LLM reviews unfamiliar spellings against the allowed scenarios; reject unresolved labels.
Sort by month and linearly interpolate only within the same business, metric and scenario; fail if unresolved.
Remove rows only when every standardized field and amount is identical.
Fail the pipeline when non-identical rows share business, month, scenario and metric.
Within the same business, metric and scenario, calculate Q1 and Q3; flag values outside the 1.5×IQR fence after applying a 50% median materiality floor, then impute in-group.
Parse source dates and standardize them to month end; fail when a required date cannot be parsed.
